name: Food Equip Parts & Services Co
old_description: This website is merely a representation of selected items that we stock or can supply.
about:
Organized in 1975, FEPSCO Inc. (Food Equip Parts & Service Co) was established in Honolulu, Hawaii, to address a gap in the local market for factory replacement parts and repair services for commercial foodservice equipment. The company has operated continuously under the FEPSCO name since its founding.

FEPSCO acts as an authorized parts distributor and service provider for a broad roster of U.S. foodservice equipment manufacturers, including Chicago Faucets, T&S Brass, Dormont, Edlund, and Wells. From its Honolulu facility, the company maintains a large inventory of parts and accessories — ranging from faucets and drain assemblies to gas connectors and can opener components — and provides both in-warranty and out-of-warranty repair services. It also supplies customers across the Pacific Rim, with most outbound shipments sent overnight to destinations such as Guam, the Marianas, American Samoa, and U.S. military installations in Okinawa, Japan, and Korea.

The company serves commercial kitchen operators of all types: restaurants, cafeterias, hospital foodservice departments, and military galleys and messes. Its customer base extends to institutional facilities and U.S. Army and Air Force bases throughout the Pacific. FEPSCO also offers technical assistance by phone, fax, or email, drawing on factory-printed and electronic documentation.

FEPSCO was created to fill a void in Hawaii's foodservice supply chain, and its differentiation lies in its manufacturer-authorized status, deep inventory, and ability to ship overnight across the Pacific. The firm emphasizes ready access to factory technical data and a willingness to source hard-to-find items on request.
